note: Issue #401: LAN play. One player hosts from F11 > Game, friends on the same wifi join by the host's address. Read by src/systems/net/net_session.gd. port: the UDP port the host listens on. max_players counts the host. send_rate: state packets a second each player sends. name_max: letters in a player's name. spawn_by_t89_m: how far from T-89 a guest stands on arrival. smooth_rate: how fast a remote body closes on where it was last heard (1/s); snap_m: further off than this it jumps. name_height: metres above the feet of the floating name. connect_timeout: seconds a join waits for the host before giving up. friendly_fire: your bolts and blade hurt the other players (each game applies the hits on its own player, times friendly_fire_scale); off, they pass through. hitbox_radius / hitbox_height: the other players' bodies, for shots and for walking into. Issue #401 (guests' ships): each guest arrives next to a free landing pad (a town box of kind 'pad' with no ship on it and no remnant_ship, the host's game decides, spawn_by_pad_m past its edge) with a ship of their own on it (guest_ship) in one of the liveries (content/look/ships.json looks), by join order, labelled ship_tag over it (ship_tag_height metres up). Call flies it to them. Every player's ship (the one they fly, else their primary) shows in the others' games; one not heard of for ship_stale_s seconds goes. No free pad: by T-89, the ship on clear ground beside the pit. One space fight: the host's game runs the fight over its planet and sends its ships fight_rate times a second; a guest who climbs out while it is on flies copies of them (AI off), each closing on where the host's will be (from its speed, at most fight_lead_max_s ahead) at fight_smooth_rate (1/s) and jumping there when more than fight_snap_m (or half its speed in metres) off. A guest's hits on a copy land on the host's ship; a kill is everyone's, and the last wave down pays everyone in the fight. No word of the host's fight for fight_stale_s and it is over for the guest (fight_over says so). For now the host's fighters only go for the host.
